test_gaussian_noise_mlp_regression: test GaussianNoiseMLP with regression task using 10 training batches and default init scale
test_gaussian_noise_mlp_classification: test GaussianNoiseMLP with classification task using 10 training batches and hidden layers
test_gaussian_noise_mlp_hidden_layers: test GaussianNoiseMLP with two hidden layers of size 10 and init scale 0.1
test_gaussian_noise_mlp_no_hidden: test GaussianNoiseMLP with no hidden layers and init scale 1.0 for both regression and classification
run_gaussian_enn_test_suite: run the parameterized Gaussian ENN test suite covering regression and classification with varied architectures
